en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 14. Ḥukaym ibn Dāwūd ibn Ḥukaym narrated to me from Salamah ibn Khaťťāb, from Zayd ibn Abī Zayd Al-Hirawi, from Qutaybah ibn Sa’īd, who said:
The Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) said: On the Day of Judgment, I will intercede for those who have come to Madīnah to my Ziyārah, anticipating (the reward from Allāh).
